floral_infrastructure_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: Heavy-duty structural elements including Sunflower mounts, Tulip terminals, Orchid caddies, and Rose-Thorn hooks. Wall loops bumped to 5 specifically around the Universal Interface Keyway air-bleed tubes to maintain clean, watertight channel seals under high torque.

sanitary_pouches_soft_tpu_85a.structural_purpose: Flexible wall storage units like the Succulent Wall Pods. Sliced in soft-touch 85A TPU with an independent air-bleed escape bore to ensure easy, vacuum-free wall mount attachment.

meal_prep_containers_food_safe_pp.structural_purpose: Hydrophobic food-contact elements including Water-Lily dish racks and Peony school meal containers. Sliced in high-shrinkage Polypropylene (PP). Enforces a mandatory 10.0mm solid brim at a perfect zero-gap offset combined with 0% cooling fan speeds to lock the plastic down flat, entirely eliminating edge-curling or bed warping bed delamination.
